ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Common, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (SetupStrike.cs:26-29) == cost 1 / ATTACK / COMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(7m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new PowerVar<StrengthPower>(2m)` (SetupStrike.cs:20-24) == both numbers. Note the second var is keyed on StrengthPower but is the amount handed to SETUPSTRIKEPower (SetupStrike.cs:37), the temporary-Strength wrapper -- the same key/target mismatch as card/demon_form, card/feeding_frenzy and card/rupture, checked rather than assumed.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: attack FIRST (SetupStrike.cs:34-36), then `PowerCmd.Apply<SetupStrikePower>(..., DynamicVars.Strength.BaseValue, ...)` (37) == `PowerCmd.apply(..., SetupStrikePower, self._strength, applier=ctx.player)`. The sim correctly uses `PowerCmd.apply` and NOT `StrengthCmd.apply` here, because SetupStrikePower is a TemporaryStrength wrapper rather than raw Strength -- the same distinction card/feeding_frenzy gets right and card/inflame deliberately diverges on. Presentation, folded in: WithHitFx and the Strength hover tip (16).
